content:
Track: SQL Foundations
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: WHERE Clause and Filtering Data
    - Lesson 4: ORDER BY and Sorting Data
    - Lesson 5: JOIN Operations (Inner, Outer, Left, Right)
    - Lesson 6: NULL Values and Handling Missing Data
    - Lesson 7: Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 8: Data Manipulation Language (DML): INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
    - Lesson 9: Data Definition Language (DDL) and Creating Tables
    - Lesson 10: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and Jupyter Notebooks
    - Lesson 2: Working with Libraries (Pandas, NumPy)
    - Lesson 3: Data Loading and Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 4: Basic Data Manipulation (Select, Filter, Sort)
    - Lesson 5: Grouping, Merging, and Reshaping Data
    - Lesson 6: Data Visualization with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 7: Interactive Dashboards with Plotly or Bokeh
    - Lesson 8: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) Techniques

   Track: Introduction to Data Analysis Tools
    - Lesson 1: Overview of Excel for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 2: Pivot Tables and Charts in Excel
    - Lesson 3: Google Sheets for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 4: Importing, Manipulating, and Analyzing Data with Google Sheets API
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Microsoft Access
    - Lesson 6: Creating Basic Queries in Microsoft Access
    - Lesson 7: Exporting and Visualizing Data from Microsoft Access
    - Lesson 8: Using Online Data Analysis Tools (Tableau Public, Power BI)

   Track: Statistics for Data Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Descriptive Statistics
    - Lesson 2: Probability Distributions
    - Lesson 3: Measures of Central Tendency
    - Lesson 4: Measures of Dispersion
    - Lesson 5: Correlation and Covariance
    - Lesson 6: Hypothesis Testing (One-Sample t-Test, Two-Sample t-Test)
    - Lesson 7: Regression Analysis Basics
    - Lesson 8: Confidence Intervals and Margin of Error

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Identifying and Handling Missing Values
    - Lesson 2: Removing Outliers and Anomalies
    - Lesson 3: Transforming and Normalizing Data
    - Lesson 4: Data Imputation Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Merging and Joining Datasets
    - Lesson 6: Handling Categorical Variables
    - Lesson 7: One-Hot Encoding and Feature Engineering
    - Lesson 8: Dimensionality Reduction (Principal Component Analysis)

   Track: Data Aggregation and Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Mean, Median, Mode Calculations
    - Lesson 2: Counts and Frequencies
    - Lesson 3: Percentages and Proportions
    - Lesson 4: Simple Moving Averages (SMA)
    - Lesson 5: Weighted Moving Averages (WMA)
    - Lesson 6: Rolling Windows in Data Analysis
    - Lesson 7: Time Series Analysis Basics
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Techniques for Data Aggregation
